title: trust.rs: Ygg/IID binding uses non-constant-time equality
description:
Line 196-197: verify_ygg_iid_binding compares &ygg_addr[8..16] == iid using standard equality.

Same concern as IID derivation check - defensive practice would use constant-time comparison.

Fix: Use subtle::ConstantTimeEq:
  ygg_addr[8..16].ct_eq(iid).into()
